title: Web Development
description: I build responsive, scalable, and performance-focused web applications, working across both front-end and back-end development. From creating intuitive user interfaces and managing application logic to designing APIs, databases, and server-side architecture, I focus on building reliable and maintainable web solutions.

title: Mobile App Development
description: I build cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, with a focus on responsive interfaces, smooth performance, and consistent experiences across Android and iOS. I work with navigation, state management, API integration, local storage, and device capabilities to develop functional and maintainable mobile applications.

title: AI/ML
description: I work with machine learning and deep learning models across the complete development pipeline, including data preprocessing, model architecture, training, evaluation, and optimization. I enjoy experimenting with different approaches, analyzing model performance, and building solutions around real-world datasets and problems.
